node.statement: Positive-retract hardening (PRH): let k,n >= 1 and let A:l-infinity(k)->l-infinity(n) and M:l-infinity(n)->l-infinity(k) be positive unital maps (equivalently, have probability-vector rows); if ||MA-I_k||_{infinity->infinity} <= epsilon with 0 <= epsilon < 1/2, then there is a stochastic idempotent E:l-infinity(n)->l-infinity(n) with ||AM-E||_{infinity->infinity} <= 2*sqrt(2*epsilon).
